q: The Indus Valley Civilization flourished around which period?
exp: The Indus Valley (Harappan) Civilization flourished c. 3300–1300 BCE. Answer: 3300–1300 BCE

q: The Great Bath is found at which Indus Valley site?
exp: The Great Bath was discovered at Mohenjo-daro. Answer: Mohenjo-daro
Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire with the help of Chanakya. Answer: Chandragupta Maurya

q: The Gupta dynasty is known as the Golden Age of which field?
exp: The Gupta period (c. 320–550 CE) is called the Golden Age of India for achievements in art, science and literature. Answer: Indian art, science and literature

q: The Ashokan inscriptions were deciphered by James Prinsep in which year?
exp: James Prinsep deciphered the Ashokan (Brahmi) inscriptions in 1837. Answer: 1837

q: Which Veda deals mainly with rituals and sacrificial formulae?
exp: The Yajurveda contains prose mantras for sacrificial rituals. Answer: Yajurveda

q: The Second Battle of Panipat (1556) was fought between Akbar and which ruler?
exp: The Second Battle of Panipat was between Akbar (led by Bairam Khan) and Hemu. Answer: Hemu

q: Who was the founder of the Nanda dynasty?
exp: Mahapadma Nanda founded the Nanda dynasty of Magadha. Answer: Mahapadma Nanda

q: The Sanchi Stupa was originally commissioned by which emperor?
exp: The Great Stupa at Sanchi was originally built by Emperor Ashoka. Answer: Ashoka

q: The Sangam literature of ancient Tamil Nadu belongs roughly to which period?
exp: Sangam literature is generally dated c. 300 BCE – 300 CE. Answer: 300 BCE – 300 CE

q: The famous physician in Chandragupta Maurya's court was?
exp: Charaka was the court physician (associated with Ayurveda) in Chandragupta's era. Answer: Charaka

q: Who wrote the Arthashastra, the ancient Indian treatise on statecraft?
exp: Chanakya (Kautilya) wrote the Arthashastra. Answer: Chanakya (Kautilya)

q: The Junagadh rock inscription of Ashoka records the repairs of which tank?
exp: Ashoka's Junagadh inscription records repairs to the Sudarshana Lake by his governor Pushyagupta. Answer: Sudarshana Lake

q: Kanishka was a ruler of which dynasty?
exp: Kanishka belonged to the Kushana dynasty. Answer: Kushana

q: The Allahabad Pillar inscription (Prayag Prashasti) was composed by whom?
exp: Harishena, court poet of Samudragupta, composed the Allahabad Pillar inscription. Answer: Harishena
